item.title: github: Enterprise managed permissions for GitHub Copilot agent operations
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Business and Enterprise admins can now centrally manage agent operation permissions. Admins can set operations to be blocked, require human approval, or run without prompting.

  • Source: GitHub
